amends: data/internal/research/soccer/preregistration-dixon-coles-v2.json (frozen 2026-09-11; its frozen file and sourceHashes are untouched)
what: The results corpus the shadow fits on and grades from moved from football-data.co.uk (corpus-football-data-v1.json) to openfootball football.json, public domain (corpus-openfootball-v1.json). Founder decision 2026-09-14: football-data.co.uk's own data page reserves its files for private individuals, not automated or commercial use.
whatDidNotChange: The model (app/src/lib/sports/soccer/dixon-coles.mjs) and the ESPN club table (app/src/lib/sports/soccer/dixon-coles-aliases.mjs) are byte-identical, so the registration's sourceHashes still verify. The new corpus keeps the club names the alias table maps to. Fixtures still come from ESPN.

equivalenceCheck.method: Every openfootball result in 2022-23 to 2026-27 joined to the previous corpus by exact (season, home, away) pairing after name mapping.
equivalenceCheck.laliga: 1551 of 1561 matched with identical scores; openfootball lacks ten 2024-25 results (history only — the forward population is 2026-27).
equivalenceCheck.serie-a: 1540 of 1550 matched with identical scores; openfootball lacks ten 2024-25 results (history only).
equivalenceCheck.2026-27: Identical finished-match counts in all three leagues on 2026-09-14 (41, 30, 18).

effect: The fitted history for 2024-25 in LaLiga and Serie A has ten fewer matches each. Forward forecasts and grades use the same 2026-27 results. Graded rows written before this date were graded from football-data finals that the join shows to be identical.
